request: Issue #329: Add a scenario-validity step before implementation. The plan/test phase currently writes tests but does not execute them, while impl/test-execute runs after implementation. Add a plan-phase runtime verification step that executes spec-local tests without implementation, records expected failures as artifacts, classifies unexpected pass invalid skipped not-run states, resolves the relationship with review-test gate-test and test-execute, adds anti-pattern guidance for tautological or impossible assertions, updates affected prompts schemas flow definition registry finalize artifacts tests and templates, then run sdd-forge upgrade.
